exact: negative regulation of RNA elongation from RNA polymerase II promoter
negative regulation of transcription elongation from RNA polymerase II promoter
related: negative regulation of gene-specific transcription elongation from RNA polymerase II promoter

definition: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of transcription elongation, the extension of an RNA molecule after transcription initiation and promoter clearance by the addition of ribonucleotides, catalyzed by RNA polymerase II.
label: negative regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II
